label: Уже
description: A 10-sentence usage card for уже (already; by now).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Completed ahead of time. With a perfective past verb 'уже' means already, marking that the task is finished sooner than expected. It stresses the result as accomplished.
Strategic focus: A point reached. Fronted 'уже' signals that a moment has arrived earlier than one might wish, here that it is already late. It motivates the decision to leave.
Strategic focus: Already in a question. 'Уже' asks whether an action has been completed by now, checking on lunch. It expects either a yes-it-is-done or not-yet answer.
Strategic focus: A state already in effect. With the negative existential 'нет' the adverb 'уже' means he is no longer home, a state that has already set in. It marks a change that has taken place.
Strategic focus: Age reached. In an age statement 'уже' underlines that a number has already been attained. It can carry a tone of how time has passed.
Strategic focus: Too late to act. 'Уже' with a perfective past stresses that the train has already departed, so the chance is gone. It conveys finality and missed timing.
Strategic focus: A change of state by now. With 'всё понятно' the adverb 'уже' marks that clarity has finally been reached. It contrasts the clear present with an earlier confused state.
Strategic focus: No longer with не. The pairing 'уже не' means no longer, marking that the employment has stopped. It is the standard way to express a state that has ended.
Strategic focus: Duration up to now. With a time span 'уже' stresses that the acquaintance has lasted three years and continues. It frames the period as accumulated by the present.
Strategic focus: Already in the future. Even with a future verb 'уже' marks that a point will arrive soon and inevitably. It lends a sense that the weekend is practically upon us.
